name: ariesnews
description: Task runner for the whole project. Backend lives in ./backend (uv), frontend in ./frontend (npm).

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.migration: cd backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest -m "not llm"
scripts.test:llm: cd backend && uv run pytest -m llm
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && cd ../frontend && npm run format
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
